lines.text: After seven days the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel, making him a watchman for the house of Israel.
If Ezekiel did not warn a wicked man who was told he would die, God would hold Ezekiel responsible.
If Ezekiel warned a righteous man not to sin and he heeded it, the man would live and Ezekiel would be saved.
God told Ezekiel to go out to the valley, where the glory of the LORD was present and Ezekiel fell facedown.
The Spirit set Ezekiel on his feet and told him to shut himself inside the temple, where he would be bound with chains.
